rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the way someone performs or does something.

example.english: This manner of doing things is pretty effective.
example.jyutping: nei5 ni1 go3 zou6 faat3 gei2 jau5 haau6 wo3

rows.note: Use this specifically for polite or well-mannered behaviour.

example.english: Their manner toward their elders is very respectful.
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 zoeng2 bui3 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6

rows.note: Use this for a person's observable conduct or characteristic behaviour, including strange habitual behaviour.

example.english: Their manner has been really strange lately.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 di1 hang4 wai4 hou2 gu2 gwaai3

rows.note: Use this for a sort or kind, especially in expressions such as 「呢種人」.

example.english: I don't like this manner of person.
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 ni1 zung2 jan4
